[[File:Scraplands-MPQ.png|thumb|right|250px|An [[armored hovertrain]] on [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]]]]
A '''train''' was a ground vehicle that moved along rails or magnetic guides.

Trains were used to [[Transport/Legends|transport]] people and supplies across the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].

During the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Battle of Coruscant]], [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] was escorted by [[Shaak Ti/Legends|Shaak Ti]] and [[Stass Allie/Legends|Stass Allie]] in a civilian [[Hovertrain/Legends|maglev train]] to an underground shelter to escape [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]].

Trains were also used to by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] to transport [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]] and cargo across the [[Spice/Legends|spice]]-mine [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]]. The [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] used hovertrains to ferry supplies and reinforcements to [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila's]] [[Hanna City|capital city]] during the [[Blockade on Chandrila]].<ref name="Strongholds">''[[Strongholds of Resistance]]''</ref>
